enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in her private bedroom, door closed for quiet rest after late studio hours
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Remains asleep. Turns onto side. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep. At 06:55, stirs. Opens eyes at 07:00.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and doing a short quiet reflection while waiting for the shared bathroom to free up after Member 1's shower
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up in bed. Stretches arms. Swings legs out of bed. Sits on edge of bed. Closes eyes. Breathes deeply. Listens for bathroom sounds. Checks phone for time. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing, brushing teeth (using the bathroom after Member 1 has finished)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Opens bathroom door. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel. Hangs towel. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with a pot of tea, keeping her labelled food items on her own shelf, having breakfast alongside Member 1 in the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out labelled food items. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out teapot. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Places teabags in teapot. Waits for kettle to boil. Pours hot water into teapot. Places lid on teapot. Lets tea steep. Opens fridge again. Takes out milk. Closes fridge. Pours tea into cup. Adds milk. Prepares breakfast. Eats breakfast. Drinks tea. Says good morning to Member 1. Cleans up dishes. Puts leftover food back in fridge. Wipes counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning prayer and quiet reflection on her own
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Closes door. Sits on bed. Closes eyes. Folds hands. Bows head. Remains still. Opens eyes. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly and reviewing the day's design brief on her phone, staying home under the lockdown
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens design brief file. Scrolls through. Reads. Puts phone down. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Closes book. Puts book down.

enriched_activities.activity: Remote design studio work on her computer at her desk lamp, sketching layout concepts for a uni deadline
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Logs in. Opens design software. Picks up sketchbook. Picks up pencil. Draws sketches. Puts pencil down. Uses computer to refine sketches. Types on keyboard. Uses mouse.

enriched_activities.activity: Refilling her tea and having a light snack, sharing a short tea break with Member 1 who is also making tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Picks up her cup. Pours tea from teapot. Adds milk. Opens cupboard. Takes out snack. Eats snack. Drinks tea. Chats with Member 1. Washes cup. Puts cup away.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing design project work on her computer, refining typography and colour studies
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens design software. Adjusts typography. Changes colors. Uses mouse and keyboard. Saves file. Takes notes. Continues working.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating her own medically safe lunch and wiping down her section of the counter, eating alongside Member 1 who is having lunch at the same time
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens fridge. Takes out ingredients. Closes fridge. Places ingredients on counter. Turns on induction cooker. Puts pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds ingredients. Stirs with spatula. Turns off stove. Plates food. Sits at table. Eats lunch. Drinks water. Stands up. Takes plate to sink. Washes plate. Wipes counter. Puts away ingredients. Chats with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and journaling quietly as a gentle check-in with her own mood
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Rests. Sits up. Picks up journal. Picks up pen. Writes in journal. Closes journal. Puts journal away. Stretches.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining an online studio tutorial and lecture for her design degree
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Logs into online platform. Puts on headphones. Listens to lecture. Takes notes. Types on keyboard. Mutes microphone. Unmutes microphone. Participates in discussion. Shares screen. Closes laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon tea break brewing a strong cup of tea, joined by Member 1 for a shared snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes teabag. Places teabag in cup. Pours hot water into cup. Adds milk. Takes snack from cupboard. Eats snack. Drinks tea. Washes cup. Puts cup away.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on her portfolio pieces and ticking off deadline tasks at her desk
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Opens portfolio file. Edits designs. Saves file. Opens task list. Checks off tasks. Picks up pencil. Sketches. Closes laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and cooking dinner, portioning and clearly labelling her own containers in the fridge and freezer, sharing the kitchen with Member 1 who is also cooking
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens fridge. Takes out ingredients. Closes fridge. Places ingredients on counter. Turns on induction cooker. Puts pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds ingredients. Stirs with spatula. Turns off stove. Takes out containers. Portions food into containers. Labels containers with pen. Places containers in fridge. Places containers in freezer. Washes pan. Wipes counter. Chats with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up her dishes and cooking space
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Takes plate to sink. Scrapes food into bin. Washes plate. Washes utensils. Dries dishes. Puts dishes away. Wipes counter. Wipes stove. Turns off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Running a load of laundry in the washing machine and tidying her toiletries, finishing before Member 3's evening bathroom slot
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Opens washing machine door. Sorts laundry. Places clothes in machine. Adds detergent. Closes door. Sets cycle. Starts machine. Tidies toiletries on shelf. Wipes sink. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening prayer and quiet contemplation in her room
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Closes door. Sits on bed. Closes eyes. Folds hands. Bows head. Remains still. Opens eyes. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening shower and skincare routine (before Member 1's night bathroom use)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Applies skincare products. Brushes teeth. Wipes face. Turns off light. Exits bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sketching and finishing design work for tomorrow's deadline by desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up sketchbook. Picks up pencil. Sketches designs. Puts pencil down. Opens laptop. Edits designs. Saves file. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a herbal tea and restocking and tidying the shared tea shelf while Member 1 winds down in Bedroom 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes herbal teabag. Places teabag in cup. Pours hot water into cup. Lets tea steep. Opens cupboard. Takes out tea boxes. Arranges tea boxes on shelf. Wipes shelf. Drinks tea. Washes cup. Puts cup away. Turns off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading and setting an alarm before switching off the light
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Changes into pajamas. Lies on bed. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Closes book. Puts book down. Picks up phone. Sets alarm. Turns off bedside lamp. Pulls blanket over. Closes eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night in her private bedroom
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Remains asleep. Breathes deeply. Remains still. Shifts position. Continues sleeping.
